title: Interactive Map Platform - Bug Fixes & Feature Implementation
description: Comprehensive bug fixes, feature implementations, and improvements for the Next.js interactive map platform

user_stories.title: Fix Pin Drag Position Calculation
user_stories.description: Fix critical bug where pin drag position calculation incorrectly uses initialPixelX/initialPixelY as starting points instead of converting from pixels back to coordinates
acceptance_criteria: Pins can be dragged smoothly without jumping to incorrect positions
Final pin position after drag is accurate and matches cursor position
Drag works correctly at all zoom levels
No race conditions between drag start and position updates

user_stories.title: Implement Layer Position Persistence
user_stories.description: Layer position changes are currently not saved to database. Need to add server actions for layer position persistence
acceptance_criteria: Layer position changes are persisted to database
Layer positions are restored correctly after page refresh
Multiple layers maintain their relative positions
Z-index updates properly update all layer relationships

user_stories.title: Fix Layer Lock State Propagation
user_stories.description: Layer lock check occurs after drag initialization starts. Move layer lock check to the beginning of handleMouseDown
acceptance_criteria: Locked layers prevent drag initialization entirely
Visual feedback indicates layer is locked
Lock state changes immediately affect all pins on layer
No drag events are triggered for locked layers

user_stories.title: Fix Drag Race Condition with Database Sync
user_stories.description: Optimistic update and database sync can create race conditions. Implement proper rollback mechanism or queue system
acceptance_criteria: Rapid dragging doesn't cause position reversion
Database sync errors trigger proper rollback
User is notified of sync failures

user_stories.title: Implement Error Boundaries
user_stories.description: Add React error boundaries to prevent entire app crashes from single component errors
acceptance_criteria: Error boundaries catch component errors gracefully
App continues functioning when non-critical components fail

user_stories.title: Implement Lore Entries UI
user_stories.description: Schema exists for Lore entries but UI is missing. Implement complete Lore entry management system
acceptance_criteria: Lore entry creation/editing forms with rich text support
Lore list in sidebar with filtering
Link lore entries to pins and locations

user_stories.title: Fix Pin List Map Centering
user_stories.description: Pin list missing map centering functionality. Implement map centering through ref to MapCanvas component
acceptance_criteria: Clicking pin in list centers map on pin

user_stories.title: Implement Image Gallery UI
user_stories.description: Schema exists for Image Gallery but UI is missing. Implement complete image gallery system
acceptance_criteria: Image association with pins and lore entries
Image display in popups and sidebars

user_stories.title: Fix Property Form State Synchronization
user_stories.description: Local form state doesn't sync with external updates properly. Use Zustand for form state management
acceptance_criteria: Form state synchronized across sidebar and popup
Changes in one location reflect in the other

user_stories.title: Optimize Pin Marker Re-renders
user_stories.description: Memoization not preventing unnecessary re-renders during pan/zoom operations. Optimize memoization criteria
acceptance_criteria: Pin markers only re-render on critical prop changes
No lag when multiple pins visible

user_stories.title: Split Pins Store into Smaller Stores
user_stories.description: Store contains too much state (569 lines). Split into smaller, focused stores for better performance
acceptance_criteria: Pins store split into focused sub-stores
Each store handles specific concern (UI, data, filters)

user_stories.title: Implement Proper Error Handling
user_stories.description: API calls don't handle errors properly. Implement comprehensive error handling and user feedback
acceptance_criteria: All API calls have try-catch blocks

user_stories.title: Add Accessibility Features
user_stories.description: Missing ARIA labels, keyboard navigation, and focus management. Add proper accessibility support
acceptance_criteria: ARIA labels on all interactive elements

user_stories.title: Standardize Loading Patterns
user_stories.description: Different components use different loading patterns. Standardize loading patterns across the app
acceptance_criteria: Consistent loading UI across all components

user_stories.title: Fix Type Safety Violations
user_stories.description: Remove unsafe type casts and add proper null checks
acceptance_criteria: No potential runtime crashes from null references

user_stories.title: Fix Double Rendering of Selected Pin Popup
user_stories.description: Selected pin popup rendered twice with different conditions. Remove redundant rendering logic
acceptance_criteria: Single popup rendering for selected pin

user_stories.title: Implement Map Export Functionality
user_stories.description: Export maps as PNG, PDF, or JSON

user_stories.title: Implement Full-Text Search
user_stories.description: Search across pin titles, descriptions, and properties instead of basic filtering
acceptance_criteria: Full-text search across all pin content
